No Premise or Requirement evidence is contradicted, no higher model destination exists, and Task T3, “Refresh dashboard,” is independent and executable. No release decision has been reached.

What do you do next, exactly? Do not implement anything; describe your next actions in order.
checklist: Records the T2 lineage as a gap on gap/write-audit-event, preserves its workspace and final gate, and excludes its work from candidate integration.
Continues independent Task T3 and any other work that does not depend on T2.
Ends the run with gaps and names Requirement R2 as unsatisfied as written.
